name: Zenra Toukou Shuukan
source:
Sayu-chan moves to a new town with her father. A small town with a small school and a small number of students. After a few weeks she's made friends with Haru-chan a girl 2 years younger and a native of the town. She tells Sayu-chan that tomorrow is the start of naked scholastics week, a tradition still kept by this small town in the country.

Thinking it's a prank Sayu-chan goes outside the next day in her clothes when Haru-chan runs up to her completely naked and tells Sayu-chan that if she doesn't take her clothes off right now she'll be in trouble! Everywhere she looks girls are going to school naked (the boys go to school naked another week).

Walking to and from school, sitting in class, going outside for physical education, everything Sayu-chan does for the next week will be done completely naked!

Note, this game contains no scenes of penetrative vaginal sex.
